title: Kalshi Joins the Kodex Network
summary: Kalshi, a federally regulated exchange, now receives law enforcement requests through Kodex, with every requester verified before a request reaches its team.
body_markdown:
> Kalshi, a federally regulated financial exchange, now receives and responds to law enforcement requests through Kodex.


We’re thrilled to welcome Kalshi to the Kodex network. Kalshi announced the partnership today on[Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-kodex-partnership-law-enforcement-requests) . Investigators can now send subpoenas, warrants, and other legal process to Kalshi through Kodex, and every requester is verified before a request reaches Kalshi’s team.


This year, betting operators and prediction markets have been one of the fastest-growing segments of law enforcement requests on Kodex. Investigators need records from these platforms more often, and the platforms need to know that every request in front of them comes from a real investigator with valid legal process.


“Kalshi aims to be a partner with law enforcement. We are confident that Kodex will improve our efficiency in responding to subpoenas and law enforcement requests,” said Lauren Bowman, Enforcement Counsel at Kalshi and a former federal prosecutor.


Kalshi’s team brings deep federal law enforcement experience. Alongside Bowman, Sean Fern, a former federal prosecutor and FBI agent, leads the company’s anti-money laundering efforts, and Tyler Neff, a former FBI Staff Operations Specialist, is a member of Kalshi’s surveillance team.


“Prediction markets are new to a lot of investigators, so Kalshi is making it simple for them to get in touch. Every request they get through Kodex comes from a verified investigator, which means their team can move fast and trust what they’re answering,” said Matt Donahue, co-founder and CEO of Kodex.


We’re excited to work with Kalshi to lead the way for prediction markets on how to work with law enforcement, and to show what doing it right looks like.


Investigators can send requests to Kalshi at[app.kodexglobal.com/kalshi](https://app.kodexglobal.com/kalshi) . Read Kalshi’s full announcement on[Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-kodex-partnership-law-enforcement-requests) .
